Name: Auto Pet Bowl
Author: Field028
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
Auto Pet Bowl fills every pet water bowl automatically at the start of each day. You no longer need to carry a watering can to the bowl every morning, and your pets still get their daily friendship from a full bowl.
That’s all it does. It doesn’t pet your animals, change friendship values, or touch anything else in the game.
[line]

[b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]You can add or remove the mod mid-save. It only fills the bowl, the same as watering it yourself, so it doesn’t save any extra data.
[line]

[b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Filled every morning:[/b] every pet bowl is filled when the day starts, rain or shine.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple pets and bowls:[/b] works with every bowl you’ve built, for any number of cats, dogs, turtles or other pets.[/*]
[*][b]Same friendship as vanilla:[/b] your pet drinks overnight and gets the normal friendship from a full bowl. Petting your animals is still up to you.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] only the host needs it installed. Farmhands don’t need it.[/*]
[*][b]No setup:[/b] no config file and no keybinds. Install it and forget about it.[/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]Shout outs[/size][/b]
Thanks to Pathoschild and the SMAPI team for the modding framework, and to the Stardew Valley Wiki for documenting how pet friendship works.
